author: Good Enough
description:
What are the rarest things in the universe? From magnetars and wandering black holes to failed supernovas, interstellar objects, and the possibility of intelligent extraterrestrial life, the universe contains astronomical objects and phenomena so rare that we've discovered only a handful, or may have never found another example at all.

Magnetars are an extremely rare type of neutron star with the strongest known magnetic fields in the universe. Their magnetic fields can be trillions of times stronger than Earth's, making them some of the most extreme objects ever discovered.

Odd Radio Circles (ORCs) are enormous, mysterious rings of radio emission discovered in deep space. Only a small number are known, and astronomers are still working to determine exactly what creates these gigantic cosmic structures.
